fullName: PSIRA security officer grade assessment (Grades E to C)

categories.label: PSIRA, the Act & the Code of Conduct

notes: PSIRA-accredited training centres run the Grade E, D and C courses and set the assessments; PSIRA's own site could not be loaded (certificate and 503 errors) when this was built, so no official count, time or pass mark is used. Four 50-question mock tests with 70% as Tigertest's target. Training sets are grouped by grade as Tigertest's own mapping of the course content (E: law, conduct, legal powers, basic access control; D: patrols, radio and reports; C: first response, emergencies and OHS). Pools are exactly 4x per-test counts. Content sets, so sets first, then tests.
